description: This file contains unit tests for the FeatureDefinitionCreated class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It verifies immutability, equality, exception handling for null inputs, JSON serialization/deserialization, and overall behavior of the class.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionCreatedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for FeatureDefinitionCreated, testing its immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that FeatureDefinitionCreated class is immutable and its FeatureDefinition component is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the proper implementation of hashCode and equals methods for FeatureDefinitionCreated.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with a null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with a null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with a null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullDefinition
methods.description: Ensures that creating an instance with a null definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method returns the expected JSON representation of the object.
